name: smwgraphics-bs-super-ninja-kun-blossom-garden
title: BS Super Ninja-Kun - Blossom Garden
description:
The background used in the first level of Super Ninja-Kun, a Satellaview exclusive videogame. A great fit for any eastern grassland or very large levels. The sample level was made using Horizontal Level Mode, since the actual background is quite large.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
